title: Dareplane proof of concept: STN LFP, ECoG and EOG during the CopyDraw task with open- and closed-loop DBS (1 Parkinson's disease patient)
description: Intracranial recordings from one Parkinson's disease patient with externalised bilateral subthalamic DBS leads and an epidural ECoG strip over left primary motor cortex. Data were acquired on days 2-4 after implantation while the patient performed the CopyDraw task with DBS off, with continuous open-loop DBS, and with closed-loop adaptive DBS run on the Dareplane platform. The dataset serves as a proof of concept for the Dareplane modular open-source BCI software platform and includes STN LFP, ECoG, EOG and stimulation/port event markers.
methods_description: Neuro Omega recordings at 22 kHz of 16 STN LFP channels (Boston Scientific Vercise directional leads), 4 epidural ECoG contacts over left M1 and 4 EOG channels during the CopyDraw task. Conditions were DBS off, open-loop DBS on, and closed-loop adaptive DBS (day 4). ECoG was referenced to the left earlobe, DBS recordings to the left mastoid, with ground on the right mastoid. Events come from the Neuro Omega hardware port and stimulation marker channels.
